title: oscore: panic between claim() and activation leaks the registry claim silently
description: ownership.rs:97-140: claim() precedes register_fresh/restore_existing; the unclaim rollback runs only on returned Err, so a panic inside a store impl locks the record until explicit release. Fail-closed direction (safe), no mutex poisoning possible, but the leak is silent. Fix: document the deliberate choice (rollback-on-panic would re-open the record; current behavior is safer), or add a drop-guard with the stated tradeoff. Discovered reviewing f4b089027c.
